    What this lab models

    Ethernet links, switch MAC learning, IPv4 LAN addressing (/1–/30), ARP and ICMP Echo in both directions. Routers use directly connected networks and longest-prefix selection. Frame transfer, ARP waiting and timing are simplified; displayed steps are a logical trace, not a real network capture.

    Ports act as auto-MDIX Ethernet. This lab does not model VLANs, spanning tree, static/dynamic routing protocols, DHCP, DNS, NAT, firewalls or Internet access. Redundant switch loops are rejected. A green ping proves only the simulated IP path, not application access.

    Prefer reduced motion? Your system preference is respected, and playback always starts paused. Use Next step to inspect changes at your own pace.
